messages:
maria (sec-eng): Auditor asked for an evidence packet showing the last RBAC update and related auth logs. They want verifiable checksums, KMS wrapping proof, and a short control map. Can we hand off without giving them bucket creds?
tom (infra): Yep, we'll produce a zipped bundle, encrypt with our KMS key, upload to evidence bucket, and hand presigned URLs. What's the desired expiry window?
auditor_sam: 48-72 hours is fine. Include sha256 for each file, the KMS key ARN used, and a CSV mapping each artifact to SOC2/ISO control IDs. Also note any redactions.
leo (compliance): Add retention notes and whether archived copies exist. Please include a small README describing how the bundle was generated and the exact CLI command used. Auditors like reproducibility.
maria (sec-eng): Good call. We'll include an ops manifest with fields: filename, sha256, s3_uri, kms_key_arn, created_by, created_at_utc, control_refs, redaction_reason.
tom (infra): Presigned URL snippet (Go SDK):
```go
svc := s3.New(sess)
req, _ := svc.GetObjectRequest(&s3.GetObjectInput{Bucket: aws.String("redwood-evidence"), Key: aws.String("rbac-bundle-2026-02-16.zip")})
urlStr, err := req.Presign(72 * time.Hour)
fmt.Println(urlStr)
```
ops-bot: upload started by job `evidence-packager` -> s3://redwood-evidence/packets/rbac-bundle-2026-02-16.zip
ops-bot: upload complete -> s3://redwood-evidence/packets/rbac-bundle-2026-02-16.zip
tom (infra): Bundle sha256: b5a1c8d9e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7. KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef01-2345-6789-abcd-ef0123456789.
leo (compliance): Please run `aws s3api head-object` on the object and include the JSON showing ServerSideEncryption and SSEKMSKeyId. Put it in /evidence-meta/head-object.json.
auditor_sam: Also need the PR link, the vulnerability ticket that prompted the change (ID + timeline), and a short explanation of the test/validation you ran after rollout.
maria (sec-eng): We'll include PR link, ticket E-410, and a short validation checklist (smoke login test, token expiry checks, ACL sampling). Any PII redactions will be annotated in the manifest with reason codes.
tom (infra): Manifest CSV sample (first lines):
filename,s3_uri,sha256,kms_key_arn,created_by,created_at_utc,control_refs,redaction_reason
rbac-bundle-2026-02-16.zip,s3://redwood-evidence/packets/rbac-bundle-2026-02-16.zip,b5a1c8...,arn:aws:kms:.../ef01-...,maria@redwood.com,2026-02-16T08:45:12Z,SOC2-CC6.1|ISO27001-A.9.4,none
head-object.json,s3://redwood-evidence/evidence-meta/head-object.json,4d2c3b...,arn:aws:kms:.../ef01-...,tom@redwood.com,2026-02-16T08:45:40Z,SOC2-CC6.1,none
incidents.csv,s3://redwood-evidence/meta/incidents.csv,9a8b7c...,arn:aws:kms:.../ef01-...,ops@redwood.com,2026-02-16T08:46:00Z,SOC2-CC5.3,E-410: redacted email addresses
maria (sec-eng): Auditors sometimes ask for signed manifests. For this delivery we'll DM the presigned link plus a signed email from security confirming the bundle integrity. Future recurring deliveries we'll aim for PGP/HSM signing.
auditor_sam: Human-signed email is acceptable for one-off. For automated recurring evidence we'll request signed artifacts to reduce manual verification. Also DM links rather than posting in channel.
tom (infra): We'll tag the S3 object with `evidence=true` and `audit_period=Q1-2026` and set lifecycle to expire after 90 days. Also add `delivered_to=auditor_sam` in object metadata.
leo (compliance): Add sampling methodology doc: we sampled 4 exports across rolling 6 months (seed=2026-02-01, exclude <5MB). Include the query we ran against audit-index so the auditor can reproduce sample.
maria (sec-eng): Noted. I'll send the presigned URL + signed note to @auditor_sam via DM and attach the bundle to the evidence tracker. Please double-check the head-object JSON has SSEKMSKeyId before sending.
auditor_sam: Received DM, starting verification. Will validate sha256 and head-object JSON and reply with acceptance or questions.
tom (infra): Attaching sanitized `aws s3api head-object` output to the bundle (account IDs redacted).
maria (sec-eng): Playbook updated at /playbooks/evidence-handoffs.md describing steps we used. Closing this thread unless auditor requests follow-up.
auditor_sam: Thanks everyone — I'll post a concise acceptance note or a short list of follow-ups after validation.
